description.narrative: The Financial Sector Support Project for Tanzania aims to increase the soundness and competitiveness of the financial sector and improve access by small savers and micro entrepreneurs to the formal financial system. The project has the following components: Component 1: aims at enhancing the soundness and efficiency of the banking sector. Component 2: will focus on promoting vibrant primary and secondary markets supported by appropriate and secure settlements system and robust oversight. Component 3: will focus on the promotion of an efficient and competitive pension sector supported by appropriate legal and regulatory structures. Component 4: focuses on promoting an efficient, sound, and competitive insurance industry with wider outreach and market based investment policies. Component 5: will support improvement in the availability and access to long term financing for enterprises, infrastructure, and housing. Component 6: will complement the existing initiatives under the FSDT and the Private Sector Competitiveness Project (PSCP) by focusing on promoting a viable and sustainable microfinance industry with wide outreach operating under an enabling legal and regulatory framework.

The Project Development Objective is to promote increased household and firm access to financial services, facilitate efficient financial intermediation, and support financial stability and integrity.
